name: 64119 · Kansas City, MO
findings: ZIP 64119 (Kansas City) has 102 nonprofit organizations. 44 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 64119 (Kansas City) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 8 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
